title: FileChangeUnrestorableReason
description: Why a change cannot be restored: unknown (the environment could not capture it, or does not restore that kind of change yet), binary (the file was binary before or after), oversized (the file was over 2 MiB before or after), imported_history (an imported session's history made it, outside the environment) or evicted (its snapshot was dropped to keep the session's 50 changes and 16 MiB).
